summary: Insolvency admission against financial creditor; standard: existence of debt and default, not dispute validity; Section 7 (IB Code) mandate for admission upon default establishment; Bank Guarantees non-extension by Bank; High Court interim order disregarded; One-Time Settlement rejection; Vidarbha Industries precedent distinguished; Innoventive Industries and E.S. Krishnamurthy judgments applied; Application admission upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; NCLAT judgment upholding NCLT admission order affirmed.
